entry_points.text: Flagless vector takes fd/vector/len/offset, native rebuilds from halves, compat uses wide or paired halves high above low; flagged adds behavior word, all-ones offset uses current-position path else positional path.

Sendfile moves input to output fd with optional caller store, absent uses current pos, present fetched/used/written back with plain ceiling or 64-bit maxima, faults on user faults; copy-range resolves fds/pos, rejects nonzero flags, delegates, advances.
Native, wide and old listings take fd/buffer/capacity, iterate, finalize last position, report bytes; empty file is bad fd, user write faults are faults.
Compat old handles one record per call with unit hint, returns emitter else iteration outcome; packed compat mirrors native with trailing fixup; empty file is bad fd.
Remap preparation forwards input/output positions, length pointer and flags to the shared helper with empty extra context and returns its outcome unchanged.
Select and pselect native/compat import optional masks, handle absent/native/old timeouts, copy or translate packed blocks, delegate to shared logic.
Poll treats negative as unbounded else deadlines with restart arming; native/compat ppoll import timeouts, install masks, use poll core, finalize remaining per form.

exports.text: Direct splice moves length between files at positions; inner bundles length, flags, positions, callback, rejects no-write or append dests, runs engine, publishes new source offset.

Copy-range allows splice hint only, validates ranges, ends empty at once, clamps for splice/offload/compat, prefers offload then remap then splice, drops write guard for splice, notifies and accounts.
Central select takes count, sets, deadline, clamps to sampled max, uses stack or dynamic maps, exports results, separates empty, signaled, invalid, alloc and fault cases, frees dynamic maps.
Seq file gives iterator read with position sync, buffered escaped/format/plain append with overflow mark, path render with escapes, and hex dump with normalized width and prefixed rows.

hazards.text: No readers means broken pipe with signal; room succeeds at once; else nonblocking retries, signals restart, else sleep; notify orders queue changes, wakes waiters, always async-signals.
Listing/offset paths risk user faults, narrowed inos, position-plus-length overflow past ceilings, malformed inputs mapping invalid/overflow without extra partial state.
Reject negative timeval parts pre-normalization; guard six-fold bitmap sizing; clamp or reject counts via single sample; map zero-ready with pending signals to restartable interrupt.

All-ones offset means current; global/filesystem/plain/64-bit ceilings, shorten to end, bounded separator-free names, pow2 aligned atomic, 100ms slack; read/write/seek/append/nonblock/direct/async/immutable/intent gate with distinct errors.

invariants.text: Sendfile needs readable source, writable dest, position from current or caller store with positioned-read check, range validation, global/filesystem ceilings with post recheck, direct or pipe path, then account, notify, advance.

Copy checks mount/offload, immutable/swap/wrap/self-overlap, shortens to end and limits; writes reject swap, handle empty/append/direct/async and trim iterator; atomic needs linear pow2 aligned len plus direct.

Shared traversal needs iterator plus security/notify allowance, rejects dead dirs, carries position, emits access events; legacy/old emitters check positive bounded separator-free names, reject narrowed inos, allow one old success, copy terminated names, map faults.

Poll containers init wake/task/trigger/pages, prefer inline and record OOM; registration pins file with key, unmatched wakes ignored else mark triggered and wake; sleep only if untriggered with absolute timeout; negative fd empty, missing invalid.

Null set pointer means all-clear with word-rounded sizing; fetch/store/clear move words; finish restores mask unless non-restart, skips sticky/zero, writes back remaining; compat moves compat words likewise.

Legacy wrapper rejects negative timeval parts; shared pselect handles absent/native/old32 timeouts, installs mask, finishes per form; compat core mirrors clamp/alloc/import/export with compat masks; unknown forms fatal.

Poll core bounds total by file limit, gathers stack head plus page extensions, runs engine, writes back readiness, frees extensions; restart resumes saved pointer/count/deadline and rearms on restartable interrupt.

Log prefix uses module name; cache pointer read-only after init; single iteration ends after current with no-op stop; list/hlist helpers walk to index with plain/RCU and head-inclusive forms, wrap maps to end.
These facilities are owned elsewhere and used here only as interfaces; their internal contracts are out of scope for this dossier.

locks.text: Pipe insert holds dest lock across wait and insert, releasing before reader notify for atomic queue changes.
Traversal uses killable shared ownership, skips immutable locks; legacy wrap drops shared, takes exclusive, revalidates, runs iterator, downgrades.
Wake marks trigger under queue sync with barrier; sleeper clears with full barrier for visibility before next check; first insertion orders initial check.
Seq seek evaluates, traverses and commits only while holding the sequence mutex, released on every exit.
Native and compat select sample descriptor table maximum under RCU read protection with prompt release for a stable snapshot.

state_machines.text: Direct engine needs seekable source and empty pipe, reuses task pipe or allocates one, keeps input blocking while draining, cycles intake/consume/account with hint, ends on terminal empty after progress, frees residue, resets, marks access.

Select validates bits, repeats scan/sleep with class-derived keys, accumulates readiness, stops queueing after progress, exits on ready/expiry/signal/OOM with busy shortcut; poll adds immediate/scan/busy/sleep with lazy expiry/slack.

Packed emitters consume aligned size, remember prior length, mask type, refuse bad names, narrowed inos, faults, bad signal context with invalid/overflow/fault codes, stop when full, patch trailing position if any placed.
Seq seek allows absolute/relative only, rejects others and negatives, updates directly if target equals read pos, else traverses to stable, resets on failure, commits read/file pos on success.

structs.text: Dir records hold ino/offset/len/flexible name; legacy size is name offset; single state pairs context, user pointer, outcome; packed native/compat tag type in last byte per ABI widths.
Packed state joins context, cursor, prior length for fixup, sticky failure; wide/compat mirror native; old single uses pointer plus outcome flag blocking second emit.
Poll pages chain via next with cursor over flex area, full past bound; chunks link successors with count/array; heap/stack caps equal size minus header over descriptor size.
Select bundle holds six word arrays for in/out/ex requests plus results with per-word access; granularity is bits per word with rounded words/bytes; compat is eight times compat word.
Mask carrier pairs pointer with length; legacy block packs count, three sets, timeval; compat uses compat fields needing translation; timeout tag lists native/old timeval/timespec from zero.
